about: Nanaimo is a harbour city on the east coast of Vancouver Island, across the Strait of Georgia from Metro Vancouver. It grew around coal mining and a protected harbour and is now a ferry, service, and recreation centre for mid-Island. Departure Bay and Duke Point terminals link the city to the mainland. About 100,000 people live in Nanaimo.
seoSummary: Vancouver Island harbour city, a ferry hub across the Strait of Georgia from Metro Vancouver.
